whatItIs.statement: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.

whenToUse.statement: Use a button when the control triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form, opening a dialog, cancelling an action, or deleting an item.

whenNotToUse.statement: Do not use a button for navigation; match the visual treatment and role to the link function.

howToUse.statement: For a link-shaped navigation control, use the buttonVariants helper with a plain link element instead of Button.
Give the button an accessible label; text content is the default accessible name.

options.statement: Use the size option to change the size of the button.
When placing an icon before or after the label, use the documented icon-position marker so the component can apply the corresponding spacing.

writing.statement: Keep a toggle button's label unchanged when its pressed state changes.

guidance.statement: When the element navigates rather than triggers an action, use a link.
